arch_hb_edmDefs: RULE: Zoning Bylaw 20001, 8.20 General Definitions (printed pages; PDF +2): Basement 'the portion of a building or structure that is wholly or partially below ground level. A Basement has a maximum Height of 1.83 m above Grade measured from Grade to the finished level of the floor directly above' (p. 1023); Floor Area 'contained within the outside surface of the exterior and Basement walls' (p. 1032); FAR excludes 'a. Basement areas used exclusively for storage or service to the building, or as a Secondary Suite; b. underground Parking Areas …; c. … Bike Parking …; d. Floor Areas devoted exclusively to mechanical or electrical equipment servicing the development; and e. indoor Common Amenity Area' (p. 1033); Site Coverage: buildings '1.8 m or more in Height above Grade' or Parkade '1.0 m or more' (p. 1052); Storey: 'If the top of the floor directly above a Basement is greater than 1.83 m above Grade, the Basement is considered a Storey' (p. 1053) — data/raw/edm/bylaw/b.txt
arch_hb_edm570: RULE: Zoning Bylaw 20001, 5.70 Measuring Height and Grade: 1.4 flat roof measured 'from Grade to the midpoint of the highest parapet'; 1.7 roof top ≤1.7 m above max Height; 1.8 flat-roof parapet top ≤0.4 m above; 1.9 'no Height limit in any Zone': chimney stacks, elevator housing and roof stairways, 'water or other tanks', 'ventilating equipment, plumbing stacks, and mechanical penthouse', skylights, fire walls, antennas, 'other similar architectural features' (pp. 822–825); 2.1.1 Grade = average elevation at Site corners before construction (p. 825–826) — data/raw/edm/bylaw/b.txt

arch_hb_vanHeightBg: GOVERNMENT GUIDE: Calculating Building Height, Regulation Redesign backgrounder, City of Vancouver, June 2019 (quotes ZDBL s. 2 as of 2019; current text not verified): Basement 'lower floor located less than 1.5 m below finished grade', floor above 'not more than 2.0 m above finished grade'; Cellar 'lower floor located 1.5M or more below finished grade'; Storey '… A storey shall not include a basement or cellar'; Base Surface 'joining the official established building grades at all corners of the site' — https://vancouver.ca/files/cov/calculating-building-height.pdf
arch_hb_vanHeightBulletin: GOVERNMENT GUIDE: Building Height Technical Design Supplement (bulletin), City of Vancouver, effective 26 Jan 2022, amended 19 Oct 2023 (read through WebFetch summary): height met 'at any point' from base surface to highest roof point or top of parapet; 'Finished grades are not used in the calculation of building height' (used for basement/cellar and storey counts); mechanical rooms may exceed only by Director's discretion under s. 10.1 — https://guidelines.vancouver.ca/bulletins/bulletin-building-height.pdf
